title: North Shore to Kaitāia: zero-additional-cash distribution feasibility
objective: Determine whether an authorised, real-world arrangement can transport eligible Christmas cards from Auckland’s North Shore to a consenting Kaitāia-area care facility, without additional cash expenditure or unpaid operational volunteer labour. The broader ambition is national distribution; this corridor is a first feasibility case.
verification_requirements: Independent human review of evidence, written permissions and costs; proof of physical delivery must be checked before any authoritative SOLVED or COMPLETED state. No personal recipient details may be published.
